scope: Requested Settings dragging and Snap focus only. The broad UI/MCP ledger stays paused and unchanged.
changes: Keep the existing focused control through the worker temporary disabled state. Bevy InputFocus and InteractionDisabled retain keyboard ownership and block activation while disabled. Hidden, removed, modal-covered and replaced-document controls still retire.

Cancel Bevy pointer state only when the retired control owns a current press/drag, walking existing ChildOf ancestry for slider thumbs. Changes to unrelated disabled/clipped controls no longer cancel a dialog gesture.
No Snap-specific focus restoration, custom pointer recognizer, replay queue or Bevy fork. The unsuccessful periodic dialog-update trial was removed.
input_method: Native macOS CUA with observation before every input; read-only MCP inspection/capture and saved-file comparison only.

ui_cases.expected: Click the displayed Snap square and toggle it with Space without reacquiring focus.
ui_cases.actual: Click changed true to false and retained Snap focus; Space changed false to true with the same binding. The ordinary palette appearance is preserved, now with a useful focus ring.

ui_cases.expected: Leave and return to Snap using production Tab/Shift+Tab, then activate it.
ui_cases.actual: Tab moved to Constraint 2: horizontal in the existing spatial order. Shift+Tab returned to Snap; Space toggled it off. This proves that local production sequence, not the full application tab order.

ui_cases.expected: Restore Snap on and finish editing without altering the existing part.
ui_cases.actual: Space restored Snap on; Finish Sketch restored the existing body and Sketch1/Extrude1 history. Undo/Redo remain disabled during sketch editing as before.

ui_cases.expected: Undo/Redo after finishing preserve the existing history behavior.
ui_cases.actual: The unchanged sketch edit added no extra modeling operation. Undo removed the original extrusion, leaving Sketch1; Redo restored Extrude1 and Body1. Read-only inspection followed the replacement session.

ui_cases.expected: Save, close and reopen the scratch model with Snap enabled and unchanged geometry.
ui_cases.actual: Saved model.json is byte-identical to the original fixture. The native file chooser reopened a fresh session with the expected body/history; editing Sketch1 showed Snap on. Finished afterward, leaving the part visible.

ui_cases.expected: Long title drags move Settings within the window without closing it or focusing its backdrop.
ui_cases.actual: On clean V11, both an unprimed and a primed drag from screenshot (1150,270) to (550,270) left Settings unchanged. Close settings stayed at (881,89) UI pixels; focus moved to Close dialog. Baseline V9 also dismissed Settings after a repeated drag toward the left edge.
ui_cases.disposition: The standard 60 Hz reactive-update trial failed and was removed. The unrelated-control gesture cancellation fix remains source-tested; it is not a full native Settings drag pass. No final V12 large-drag pass is claimed.

source_checks.regression_scope: Real Bevy schedules/window events. The first covers three temporary-disable cycles, disabled Space suppression, reenabled Space and hidden-focus retirement. The second covers a sibling becoming disabled during standard dialog dragging and release.

verified_in_native_ui: Snap enabled after close/reopen and Edit sketch

settings_blocker.reason_stopped: docs/contributing/surface-qualification.md limits one initial repair investigation to two repair/rebuild cycles or 30 minutes. The cap was reached; no heavy workaround was added.
settings_blocker.next_hypothesis: Bevy picking documents a hover map based on the final pointer position of a frame. Batched native press/move delivery may therefore target a different surface. This is a source-informed hypothesis, not a proven native event trace. A future bounded investigation should compare event delivery with hit selection.
settings_blocker.standard_update_trial: Bevy reactive 60 Hz updates while a floating dialog was open did not fix the long drag; removed completely from final source.
settings_blocker.retained_source_fix: An unrelated sibling changing availability no longer clears the dialog-owned Bevy press state.

capture_assertions: All retained inspection pairs match clean builds. Every capture is presented/applied and its submitted/layout revisions agree.
gif_format: Labeled native step captures, not real-time recordings; review crops/resizes only.
limits: Large Settings dragging is still a functional blocker, not an accepted cosmetic difference.
Prior small dialog move/resize passes are retained at their original revisions; no new blanket drag/resize acceptance is claimed.
Other platforms, full keyboard traversal, screen readers, input-method edge cases and all dialog/tool combinations remain outside this focused run.
MCP mutations tested: zero. Broad surface qualification remains paused.
PR remains draft and experimental-ui-widgets remains opt-in.
